items.content:
Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin
The Standard Chartered and Animoca Brands joint venture previously targeted retail access as early as the end of 2026, but its CEO declined to reaffirm that timeline.
Standard Chartered-backed stablecoin venture Anchorpoint says it will take a cautious approach to opening its Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin to retail users, declining to confirm a launch date after rival HSBC rolled out RedCoin, according to the South China Morning Post.
The venture released its institutional stablecoin product in August and previously indicated a retail offering could arrive as early as the end of 2026.
Anchorpoint CEO Dominic Maffei declined to confirm that timeline at a Friday press conference, saying the company would take a prudent approach.
“We believe it’s important to build the market out in a long-term, sustainable manner,” Maffei said, adding that rushing a launch “does not make sense.”
The update comes after HSBC launched its Hong Kong dollar-backed RedCoin on Friday for the 3.3 million users of its PayMe app.
Anchorpoint grew out of a partnership between Standard Chartered, Animoca Brands and telecommunications provider HKT, which was announced in February 2025, following their joint participation in Hong Kong’s stablecoin issuer sandbox in July 2024.
Animoca’s role is to bring its blockchain expertise and industry network to the venture and help develop uses for the stablecoin across the Web3 ecosystem.
Related: HashKey begins beta distribution of Hong Kong-regulated HKDAP stablecoin
items.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint says it’s not rushing retail stablecoin

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest
Similar to the Hugging Face hack, Ethereum researchers have set up an AI Agent message board to help rescue the Glamsterdam fork. ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site successfully hacked.
AI agents message board set up to rescue Glamsterdam fork
The second and final testnet for Ethereum’s Glamsterdam hard fork was cancelled this week, after ChainSecurity found vulnerabilities in two gas scaling Ethereum Improvement Proposals that could have spelled big trouble for at least 13 DeFi contracts.
The bugs were connected to EIP-8037/8038 and resulted in contracts, that rely on the way gas currently behaves, breaking when a call runs out of gas. It’s all fairly technical and complicated, but the upshot is that an attacker may have been able to exploit the resulting vulnerabilities.
The hard fork testnet dress rehearsal on Hoodi is not expected to be rescheduled until all the second order effects of the fork have been gamed out properly. In an article on X today, Derek Chiang from Ethlabs noted the issues were found very late in the process, which is less than ideal, “causing everyone to scramble to deal with the fallout.”
“In the future, protocol designers would do well to conduct much more thorough analysis of potential breakages that their update might introduce, and to do so much earlier in the process.”
Chiang says two researchers from Ethlabs and the Ethereum Foundation had independently spun up a bunch of AI Agents to scan contracts for vulnerabilities. When they realized they were both employing the same strategy they “set up a message board for their agents in the form of a github repo” to coordinate the work.
He noted the similarities to the OpenAI <> Hugging Face hack where rogue agents had set up a message board to coordinate the attacks. “Well, turns out the same pattern is useful for the good agents too,” he said. The exercise has been so successful at finding potential problems that a second board has been set up to examine the effects of EIP-8198, aka “Quick Slots”, which has been proposed for the subsequent Hegota hard fork.
Steal My Bitcoin site aims to prove Bitcoin isn’t vulnerable to PHP2Shell scare
Updated October 26 12.10am UTC with the result of the challenge.
A new website that hadn’t been patched for the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities offered a Bitcoin prize in a challenge related to the biggest cybersecurity scare of the year. The ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site hid the key to a Bitcoin wallet worth around $2000 which was accessible to the PHP user account through a binary called print-flag.
Source: StealMyBitcoin
The site generated a huge amount of interest and went offline periodically offline due to heavy traffic and probing attempts. 
It was solved by KillerBoi who successfully extracted the private key, however it turned out not to be the key for the wallet address shown on the site. The organizer James Pavur acknowledged the mistake and said the funds would be transferred.
WordFence founder Mark Maunder said the despite the key being extracted within a day: “This is the absolute best explanation you’ll see on how hard #php2shell is to exploit. The author had to trigger a precise memory corruption condition, leak internal memory addresses, bypass aslr, reverse engineer php’s internal memory structures, forge structures to hijack execution, and account for php build differences, worker behavior and timing.”
PHP is a programming language widely used to power websites and web applications, including content management systems. Government agencies and other organizations in the Netherlands, Australia, Japan, Finland and elsewhere took critical websites offline Wednesday as a precaution while emergency patches were developed for two related critical vulnerabilities. The flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on affected servers without logging in.
Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet
Solana’s first major consensus upgrade, Alpenglow, went live on mainnet around 1:54 pm UTC on Wednesday, according to the Solana Foundation’s Alpenglow dashboard.
Agave developer Anza said the time it takes a transaction to become final has now fallen from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 150 milliseconds. In the wake of the upgrade DeFi activity has been flat or fallen slightly — but it’s early days yet.
The upgrade’s first phase, Votor, replaces the existing voting and finalization mechanism with direct validator voting and a certificate-based system, which is expected to result in the headline transaction count falling by around 60%. A later phase will introduce Rotor, a new block data-distribution protocol intended to replace Turbine.
Starknet votes to start work on becoming a post-quantum L1
Starknet’s community has voted to support research into becoming an independent, post-quantum layer-1 blockchain.
A governance vote that ran for seven days drew about 3,200 votes, with 93.52% of voting power in favor of the transition.
The actual shift itself would require a separate, binding governance vote. For now, Starknet will continue operating as an Ethereum layer-2 network.
“We’re beginning work on a whitepaper even before we start the weekend, and hope to release a draft for public scrutiny in November,” StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson told Cointelegraph. Starknet saw the biggest fall of the top 100 coins this week, erasing one quarter of its value.
Source: Cointelegraph
US senator probes Tether after reported deal with ex-Trump crypto adviser
Senator Richard Blumenthal — the top Democrat on the Senate’s investigations subcommittee — has requested information from Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino after the Wall Street Journal reported the stablecoin firm had inked a $6.3 million deal with a marketing company co-founded by former White House crypto adviser Bo Hines.
In a Thursday letter to Ardoino, the Connecticut lawmaker said that the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations demanded “records and information related to contracts, payments, communications, and lobbying” about the deal. The politician believes it may contravene rules around ethics, corruption and lobbying. Tether says an external investigation “found no evidence of wrongdoing.”
Winners and Losers
At the end of the week, Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.2% to trade at $80,549, Ethereum (ETH) is down 1.9% to trade at $2,343 and XRP (XRP) is up 0.9% to $1.20. The total market cap is at $2.68 trillion according to CoinMarketCap.
Among the biggest 100 cryptocurrencies, the top three altcoin winners of the week are MemeCore (M) with a 24.4% gain, Venice Token (VVV) on 14.8%, and Ethena (ENA) on 14.1%.
The top three altcoin losers of the week are Starknet (STRK) which was down 24.9%, Aerodrome Finance (AERO) down 12.5% and Sei (SEI) down 12.5%.
Bitcoin weekly chart. Source: CoinMarketCap
Prediction of the Week
JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
JPMorgan Asset Management projects Bitcoin (BTC) will outperform stocks and gold over the next decade, but cautions that its volatility makes it unsuitable for diversifying portfolios for now.
On Monday, JPMorgan published its 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report, projecting a 10% annualized return for Bitcoin, compared with 7.5% for large-cap US stocks and 5.5% for gold.
“At the moment, we do not make a case for Bitcoin as a diversifier in portfolios due to its unstable market correlations,” the report said. “We see Bitcoin as a speculative asset and a hedge against monetary easing.”
Top FUD of the Week
New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
New York Attorney General Letitia James has asked a court to order defunct crypto and forex trading platform NovaTech’s founders, Cynthia and Eddy Petion, and related companies to pay $1.37 billion over its Ponzi scheme.
More than 11,000 New Yorkers lost tens of millions of dollars through NovaTech and an earlier crypto mining scheme, AWS Mining, the AG’s office said. The complaint alleged that promoters targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities through prayer groups, social media and WhatsApp, promising high returns and recruitment bonuses.
Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
Bitcoin Core is changing how it handles security vulnerabilities, due to how fast large language models can uncover software flaws.
Bitcoin Core developer Antoine Poinsot said that in the past, vulnerabilities were generally kept under lengthy disclosure embargoes to give users time to upgrade before details became public.
However, Poinsot said LLMs have made some flaws so easy to rediscover that delaying fixes offers little protection.
“The embargo period achieves little but it delays the availability of a fixed release,” said Poinsot. “We are therefore updating our policy disclosure to accommodate those.”
Pentagon bans US forces from using military info to bet in prediction markets
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has barred all Pentagon staff from using undisclosed information to place wagers on upcoming military action, including on prediction market platforms like Kalshi and Polymarket.
In a memo sent to senior Pentagon and defense agencies on Tuesday, Hegseth said all Department of War personnel are prohibited from engaging in financial transactions using nonpublic information. This involves both classified and unclassified information.

[332451b]: DeepSeek claims $38 of revenue per GPU, per hour for Flash V4. That is $332,880 per GPU, per year. But presumably they also work hard on optimizations, and it's not so crazy to think they had or still have a lot of wiggle room to ad...

With today's news, I thought I'd share this great program:

“When I was growing up in the hills of East Tennessee, I knew my dreams would come true. I know there are children in your community with their own dreams. They dream of becoming a doctor or an inventor or a minister. Who knows, maybe there is a little girl whose dream is to be a writer and singer.

The seeds of these dreams are often found in books and the seeds you help plant in your community can grow across the world.” --- Top Comments --- [arjie]: My daughter receives books through this program and I was curious how it was sustained at a $2.5/book wholesale cost. Interestingly, the coordinating body that selects books, facilitates distribution, and negotiates wholesale pricing is the Dolly Parton Imagination Library, but per-book funding is actually entirely through local charities and so on. This means that where charities are unable to act as partners, children will not receive books, but it also means that the program can opera... [labrador]: Dolly Parton was a beautiful spirit and my life was measurably improved by reading as a child so I donated $50 on her death. It's not much but I'm retired on a fixed income. I had to do something. [peterleiser]: In Tennessee hospitals a nurse, staff member, or authorized volunteer will swing by your room in the mother-baby unit and sign you up. Then you start receiving free books by mail each month until age 5. An amazing program by an amazing person! [sarchertech]: My 5 year old just got his last imagination library book. It showed up right after Dolly passed away. There was a letter from Dolly to him that ended “I will always love you”. Made my wife tear up. [dead_hn_theory]: We should be more ambitious with the people we build.

[snitty]: This is an example of why I'm a little stumped about why people are excited about Jev-style decision models. For any application at scale it'd be way more accurate to have a dedicated classifier using the right architecture (neural net, bayesian, etc.) LLMs drive the cost of making those models down to near zero. I'm surprised he's surprised. > A small, old, specialised network using an outdated architecture recognises skin lesions far better than two frontier LLMs. Yes of course. A 30m params Katago network with one playout is superhuman in playing go, while frontier LLMs have over 10,000 times more parameters and aren't any good at playing go. They're good at other things (such as helping you...

[Legend2440]: > I used Inception v3 pretrained on everyday photographs and then fine-tuned all layers on 68,011 dermoscopic and clinical images from the ISIC Archive on a single H100 GPU. >These 200 test lesions, and every other photograph of the same lesion or patient, were removed from its data (including the validation set) before training, so it had never seen them, and they were not used to choose the model or set its threshold. This is just benchmaxxing. A benchmaxxed model will always beat an ...

What if the images aren't perfect examples and happen to contain out of distribution content like a tattoo?

[MitPitt]: And a calculator outperforms LLMs at multiplication and division...

In brief
- Six more companies, including Wells Fargo, Cisco, and Marvell, have objected to trading of their shares on OKXICE TSV, according to its Oct. 23 notice.
- That brings the total to 22, up from nine on Oct. 15, though the notices don’t explain the companies’ reasons or what the objections do.
- The notice also discloses risks, including no circuit breakers beyond halts, no protections against transaction reordering, and smart contract upgrades without advance notice.
The list of companies that don’t want their shares traded on OKX and ICE’s planned tokenized stock venue keeps growing.
Wells Fargo, Cisco Systems, and Marvell Technology are among six new issuers named in an updated public notice from OKXICE TSV dated Friday. Arm Holdings, Moderna and Intuit round out the new additions. That brings the total to 22 objecting companies, up from 16 on Oct. 19 and nine on Oct. 15.
Earlier objectors include Microsoft, Alphabet, Goldman Sachs, Verizon, Broadcom, and UnitedHealth Group. None of the notices explain the companies’ reasons, or what effect an objection has on whether a stock can trade on the platform.
Wells Fargo joins Goldman Sachs as the second major U.S. bank on the list. Arm, Cisco, and Marvell add more chip and networking heavyweights to a roster already crowded with tech names, including Microsoft, Broadcom and Qualcomm.
OKXICE TSV, a 50-50 joint venture between NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange and OKX’s U.S. holding company, plans to let approved users trade tokenized U.S. stocks 24/7. Trades would run through Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on OKX’s XLayer blockchain, paired with stablecoins such as USDC.
The venue is set to operate under the SEC’s innovation exemption, which the agency unveiled in September after the Clarity Act stalled in the Senate. Since its Oct. 19 notice, the venue has said it can list shares tokenized by issuers themselves as well as by outside parties, a path none of the objectors appear to have taken yet.
The latest notice spells out the venue’s risks in detail. Beyond pausing when the underlying stock is halted, it doesn’t use circuit breakers. It has no policies addressing maximal extractable value, the profit traders can capture by reordering transactions on a blockchain.
It warns that broker-dealers trading there face unsettled questions about trade reporting and best execution, which could limit their participation and thin out liquidity. Administrators can also upgrade the smart contracts without advance notice to users, and the contract that controls who can trade has been audited only internally.
OKX and ICE first teamed up on tokenized securities earlier this year before unveiling the venue this month. Nasdaq, which won SEC approval for its own tokenized securities pilot, has said it will opt its shares out of the exemption. The IMF recently found real demand for tokenized stocks, especially during off hours when the stock market is closed, but warned that the market remains volatile and illiquid.

ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.
European Central Bank Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said the digital euro that is set for a pilot next year has the potential to give the bloc “sovereignty” over a payments infrastructure that currently requires dependency on external, non-European third parties.
Cipollone said in an interview with Italy’s Milano Finance published by the central bank on Saturday that because the bloc is critically dependent on third parties, it’s not easy to ensure this smooth functioning. He did not cite specific third parties.
“In recent years Europe has learned that, for some essential services, we cannot rely only on third parties. We saw this with energy and we’re seeing it today with defense. And the same is true for payments,” he said.
The pilot will use real transactions by ECB and national central bank staff. With 36 market operators, including seven from Italy, collaborating on preparations, the ECB is inviting e-commerce and mobile-commerce operators to participate.
“The smooth functioning of payment systems is one of our responsibilities. If we are critically dependent on third parties, it’s not easy to ensure this smooth functioning,” Cipollone said.
To be sure, sovereignty doesn’t mean shutting third parties out, Cipollone said. “It means having the power to choose and knowing that, for an essential service like payments, Europe can also rely on its own strength.”
In an April public lecture held in Latvia, Cipollone said that Europe’s reliance on non-European payment providers creates a strategic vulnerability. He said two-thirds of euro-area card transactions are governed by non-European companies, and that the digital euro could reduce that dependence and provide European-controlled payment infrastructure.
The ECB Governing Council can only decide on issuing a digital euro only after legislative negotiations in Brussels conclude.
“We hope that the regulation will be adopted by the end of the year, enabling the ECB’s Governing Council to issue a formal decision on issuance,” Cipollone told Milano Finance .

In brief
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $137.9 million on Friday but ended the week up about $301 million, snapping a two-week losing streak.
- The funds remain down about $314 million for October, while Ethereum ETFs are down roughly $1.18 billion for the month.
- Bitcoin slipped 1.1% to about $80,490, and Myriad traders raised the odds of a drop to $77,500 this month to 43%.
Bitcoin ETFs ended a choppy week in the green, but only just.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $137.9 million on Friday, according to Decrypt’s ETF tracker, their second straight day of outflows. The two-day slide totaled about $773.5 million, eating into a $1.07 billion inflow run from Monday through Wednesday.
Even so, the funds finished the week up roughly $301 million, snapping a two-week losing streak.
October, though typically a seasonally good month for Bitcoin holders, remains in the red. The funds briefly turned positive for the month midweek, but Thursday’s $635.6 million exit, the biggest of October, flipped them back. They’re now down about $314 million for the month. Cumulative net inflows stand at $57.6 billion, with $100.2 billion in total net assets.
Ethereum ETFs eked out a $4.4 million inflow on Friday but lost about $221 million on the week, leaving them down roughly $1.18 billion for October. Solana ETFs saw no net flows Friday after shedding $8.9 million Thursday, and they’re down about $68 million this month.
Spot crypto ETFs hold the underlying asset, such as Bitcoin or Ethereum, and trade on stock exchanges like ordinary shares, giving investors exposure through a regular brokerage account. Bitcoin funds have drawn $57.6 billion in net inflows since debuting in January 2024, and Ethereum funds have taken in $12.7 billion since launching that July. Solana funds arrived late last year. Because issuers report flows daily and much of the money comes from institutions and financial advisers, the figures have become a closely watched gauge of investor sentiment.
Prices slid into the weekend. Bitcoin fell 1.1% over 24 hours to about $80,490 on Saturday and is down 1.2% on the week, according to CoinGecko.
Ethereum dropped 2.6% to roughly $2,344, Solana fell 2.8% to about $101, and total crypto market cap slipped 1.2% to $2.79 trillion. The weakness follows a midweek selloff in global markets, when oil climbed above $111 a barrel and AI stocks slid.
Traders on Myriad, a prediction market developed by Decrypt’s parent company Dastan, have grown more bearish on Bitcoin’s October finish. They now give Bitcoin a 43% chance of dropping to $77,500 before the month ends, up from 32% a day earlier, and an 18% chance of falling to $75,000.
The odds of Bitcoin topping $87,500 have fallen to 10% from 17%. Solana bulls barely edge out bears, with 51.6% odds of reaching $160 before $40, down from 54.9%. Ethereum’s odds of hitting $3,000 before $1,500 held at 61.3%.
The week opened on a brighter note, after J.P. Morgan Asset Management projected 10% annual returns for Bitcoin over the next decade, but Bitcoin has since settled into what analysts have described as a “wait-and-see” mode.

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
分析：比特币链上「乱码铭文」实为测试机器人Babel Scribe

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，：Galaxy Research 发文称，过去约三周有人几乎每天约 40 次向比特币写入形似密文的句子，例如「Ieqkenszm aalzrnbgtr…」，但统计显示并非加密。562 段文本中 26 个字母出现频率均约 3.6%–4.2%，重合指数约 0.0385，接近随机；维吉尼亚式密钥长度检验亦无峰值，词长分布更像随机字母拼成的「伪散文」。

链上行为呈机器人特征：每笔交易单输入、新找零地址加一条 OP_RETURN，共约 31 条资金链、最长 86 跳，长文约每 6 小时、短文约每 90 分钟，日产量由约 12 笔升至约 40 笔，且集中在 UTC 05、11、17、23 点附近确认，周末与夜间亦不间断。资金可追溯至 5 月三笔共约 0.033 BTC 的交易平台提现，同一批币曾在 5 月 29 日以约 4.4 万字节 OP_RETURN 刻入完整美国宪法，其间还出现 Hello world、Lorem ipsum、标明「upload test」的 JSON，以及独立宣言和多语种乱词、二进制碎片。

Galaxy Research 测算，该主体累计投入约 333 万聪，约 24% 已付矿工费，约 76% 仍留在自有地址，无人收款。团队将其称为 Babel Scribe，判断是在主网测试数据发布工具，而非传递密信，并建议不必再解读这些文本。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373599

items.author: Cointelegraph by Robert Lakin
items.content:
Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions
Ahead of elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel could turn to blockchain and crypto to skirt potential international sanctions, to the dismay of opponents and the country’s central banker.
Blockchain has become an issue in this week’s Israeli elections after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Friday that the country could turn to cryptocurrency to avoid strains on the economy from any potential international financial sanctions.
He told a local television interviewer that Israel is exploring the use of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies as a means of circumventing potential banking sanctions.
“Blockchain is an alternative to sanctions,” the prime minister said in an interview with Israel’s Channel 10 economic network on Friday.
His calling blockchain a “national strategic tool” signals a pivot in the government’s stance on the digital currency industry, from an investment event into part of the country’s economic defense strategy, reported CryptoJungle, Israel’s largest crypto media platform.
A dozen Western countries have announced sanctions targeting goods from Israeli settlements in the West Bank in response to Jewish settler attacks on Palestinians and an increase in settlement construction approved by Netanyahu’s right-wing government. Those sanctions could extend into Israel proper, economists and industry figures told The Times of Israel last month.
Several of the candidates seeking to replace Netanyahu in the Oct. 27 elections, as well as the head of the Bank of Israel, were quick to challenge the prime minister’s statement.
“The BibiCoin vision is a threat to national security,” wrote Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot in a Saturday morning X post, using a play on Netanyahu’s nickname. The Bank of Israel in a statement rejected Netanyahu’s proposition, saying that cryptocurrencies “cannot be used as a route for bypassing sanctions.”
Recommended: MoonPay buys crypto security firm Sodot in $100M push into institutional crypto
Sharp reaction on the street and in the media
At Saturday evening’s anti-government rally in Tel Aviv, several onlookers weighed in on Netanyahu’s blockchain statement.
“An economy that runs on the dark web makes us no better than our enemies,” said Aryeh Cohen, holding a sign that said in English “enough Bibi’s B.S.” Another rally attendee who gave only her first name, Pnina, told Cointelegraph “what’s next, the Bank of Israel living ‘neath the law.”
Media critics also lambasted the idea of use of crypto to skirt sanctions.
“The crypto element deserves particular scrutiny. Digital currencies can indeed move value outside some traditional banking channels,” wrote Yediot Ahronot columnist Nadav Eyal in an X post. “But they are not a substitute for a national financial system. They don’t provide credit lines to banks, they don’t replace international capital markets, and they don’t persuade foreign companies to violate sanctions that bar them from doing business with Israel.”
“Crypto & blockchain-based solutions are not the tool for bypassing sanctions,” Ben Samocha, founder of CryptoJungle, told Cointelegraph on Sunday. “As demonstrated by the US Treasury against Iran, blockchain investigation allows tracking illicit funds, blocking their fiat gateway, and even freezing them.” He said that the Israeli economy is not fit to bypass sanctions using crypto.
Magazine: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
items.title: Netanyahu floats use of blockchain as solution to potential financial sanctions

分析：BTC场内多空两侧新仓位同时堆积，波动放大或即将到来

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，市场分析师 Murphy 表示，昨日的市场下探，目前观察到是部分提前充入交易平台的筹码趁着周末低流动性，对盘面进行施压。值得注意的是，当前在链上却完全没有情绪表达。比特币实体口径的实现亏损不仅没上升反而还下降。

这里有个关键因素，就是发生时间在周末。做市商、对冲基金等机构的头寸调整要到周一工作日才会进行。所以可以简单理解，昨天的短线下探仅由交易平台层面的筹码驱动。自 10 月 14 日以来，永续合约未平仓量持续堆积，在行情每次回落时都没有完成减仓，而昨天的下跌也未完成去杠杆。当前场内多空两侧同时堆积新仓位，接下来大概率还会出现一次放大的波动，将观察哪一侧先被触发。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
SemiAnalysis：英伟达与内存高利润面临2028变局，AI基建受制于融资与供应链

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，SemiAnalysis 创始人 Dylan Patel 与 Bernstein 分析师 Stacy Rasgon 近日指出，AI 基础设施投资虽仍有空间，但正面临融资成本攀升与供应链受限的双重考验。美国 10 年期国债收益率突破 5%，部分新兴云服务商无担保债券收益率逼近 15%，而承接近一半建设需求的非超大规模云厂商往往缺乏足够资产负债表支撑。缺乏长期采购承诺（offtake agreement）的项目越来越难获得资金，融资能力正成为 AI 扩张的重要分水岭。与此同时，基板、HBM、光学互联组件及洁净室产能均面临短期难以解决的瓶颈。生产同等容量 HBM 所需晶圆数量约为 DDR5 的 3 至 4 倍，加剧了产能竞争；新建洁净室要到 2027 年才陆续投用。相比之下，电力短缺可通过现场燃气轮机、燃料电池等方式部分缓解。

针对核心产业链，两位分析师警示了 2028 年的潜在转折。英伟达目前仍通过持续的性能提升支撑高售价，但 Google TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 以及 OpenAI 等企业的自研芯片布局，正为大型客户提供替代选择并增强其议价能力。即使英伟达收入继续增长，其市场份额与利润率也未必同步提升。内存行业方面，当前 HBM 毛利率高达 88% 至 90%，但市场并未给予极高估值，核心担忧在于 2028 年后新增产能集中释放。若届时扩产速度超过需求增量，叠加 AI 需求增速放缓，当前的高价格与高利润将面临逆转。在企业端，大多数企业将更倾向于通过云服务购买 Token，而非自建算力，这意味着未来 AI 基础设施的需求将高度取决于推理服务的使用量。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373593
items.title: SemiAnalysis：英伟达与内存高利润面临2028变局，AI基建受制于融资与供应链

慢雾：Yapeswap因治理零法定人数遭攻击，损失约2.19万美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，慢雾 SlowMist 发出安全预警称，去中心化交易平台 Yapeswap 遭攻击，损失约 2.19 万美元。根因是 WorkersUnion 治理法定人数为零，攻击者仅凭约 0.000055% 的投票权便通过提案，将 YapeFactory 的 feeToSetter 权限转至己方。攻击者随后安装恶意 Registry，使 latestVault() 返回虚假金库，而 vaults() 仍列出真实金库。YapePair 将遭挪用的存款计为 farming 资产，却未获得可赎回份额。

当前主流CEX、DEX资金费率显示市场看跌态势减弱

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，据 Coinglass 数据，随着比特币小幅反弹，当前主流 CEX、DEX 资金费率显示市场看跌态势减弱，具体资金费率如附图所示。

BlockBeats 注：资金费率是加密货币交易平台为了保持合约价格与标的资产价格之间的平衡而设定的费率，通常适用于永续合约。它是多空交易者之间的资金交换机制，交易平台并不收取此费用，用于调整交易者持有合约的成本或收益，以使合约价格与标的资产价格保持接近。

当资金费率为 0.01% 时，表示基准费率。当资金费率大于 0.01% 时，代表市场普遍看多。当资金费率小于 0.005% 时，代表市场普遍看跌。

items.content:
韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，据《首尔经济日报》报道，韩国总统府已决定再次推迟原定于明年 1 月实施的加密资产所得税征收。韩国总统府相关人士于 25 日表示，相关讨论已倾向于推迟实施。韩国政府此前于 2020 年通过修订《所得税法》，决定对加密资产收益征税，但该政策已三度延期。按原计划，相关税制应于 2027 年 1 月 1 日起实施。

根据修订后的《所得税法》，加密资产转让或出借产生的年度收入，在扣除 250 万韩元的基本免税额后，将按 22% 的税率征税，其中包括其他所得税和地方所得税。据悉，韩国方面还考虑到美国将于 2029 年起参与加密资产自动信息交换框架（CARF），因此决定推迟征税。CARF 是一项国际税务信息交换机制，各国税务机关可从加密资产服务提供商处收集用户的居住地及交易信息，并在国家之间相互交换。由于美国作为加密资产交易规模较大的市场，参与时间较晚，若韩国提前实施征税，可能导致税负过度集中于韩国本土交易平台用户。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373585

CoinDCX旧钱包基础设施遭攻击损失1599万枚USDT，将由公司自行承担

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，CoinDCX 发文披露，10 月 21 日，该平台发现系统出现异常活动，相关控制措施和应急响应机制避免了活跃钱包及交易系统受到影响。但 10 月 22 日，平台通过链上数据及用户反馈发现异常资金流动。进一步调查显示，此次事件涉及一套已于 2025 年 7 月 19 日安全事件后弃用的旧钱包基础设施，该基础设施仍存在未知漏洞，且自动归集服务曾在一段时间内失效，导致资金持续累积于已弃用地址，最终造成 1599 万枚 USDT 损失，相关损失由公司承担。

CoinDCX 表示，尽管旧钱包基础设施已被弃用，部分用户仍因未及时更新地址，将资金存入旧地址。为避免用户资金无法追回，平台采用独立的入账与资金归集流程：用户存款到账后，系统会立即将相应金额计入用户账户，随后通过自动归集服务将资金转入 CoinDCX 主要安全钱包。此次事件中，归集服务出现故障，导致累积资金面临风险。不过，平台强调，活跃交易及钱包系统始终正常运行，用户交易、存款和提现未受影响，用户资产仍由独立隔离的安全冷钱包保管。

CoinDCX 提醒用户，每次存款前均应通过官方应用或网站核实最新充值地址，避免向已弃用地址转账。平台称，过去 72 小时内所有系统均持续正常运行，未出现服务中断、提现限制或交易受阻的情况。后续，CoinDCX 将加强对遗留系统的监控与安全控制，并定期提醒用户及时更新充值地址。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373584

【韩国决定再次推迟加密资产征税】

Foresight News 消息，据《首尔经济日报》报道，韩国总统府已决定推迟原定于 2027 年 1 月 1 日实施的加密资产所得税征收。总统府相关人士 10 月 25 日表示，加密资产征税已朝推迟实施方向讨论。韩国政府于 2020 年修订所得税法决定对加密资产所得征税，此后已三次推迟实施。根据该法案，加密资产转让及出借产生的年度所得在扣除约 1889 美元（250 万韩元）基本免税额后，将适用 22% 的税率。报道称，此次推迟主要考虑征税准备不足、青年群体舆论，以及美国将于 2029 年起参与加密资产报告框架（CARF）等因素。执政党内已有议员提出自 2029 年起实施征税的修正案，国民力量党也主张推迟，相关法律修订预计将在 11 月税法审议过程中完成。总统府将在本月国政监查结束后召开党政协商会，就加密资产征税作出最终决定。

Four.Meme推出Binance Agent ID专属模式，面向BSC AI代理打造

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，据官方消息，Four.Meme 宣布推出 OpenFour 新启动模式「Binance Agent ID 专属模式」，专为 BNB Chain 上的 AI 代理打造，并由 Binance Wallet 提供支持。在绑定曲线阶段，交易仅限拥有 Agent ID 的 Binance Agentic 钱包参与，每个钱包最多可购买代币总供应量的 1%，且代币不可转让；代币完成毕业后，交易将向所有用户开放。用户只需在 Binance Agentic 钱包中启用开发者模式，即可参与交易。

该模式允许任何钱包发起代币启动，支持使用 BNB 筹集资金，并可选择启用交易税。开发者可在启动前预购相当于筹资金额最高 1.5% 的代币，并在绑定曲线上出售，但代币启动后不可继续买入。通过该模式启动的所有代币，均将在 Four.Meme 平台上标注「.ai」标签。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Kimi训练AI老板，General Reasoning训练整家AI公司

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 1 月，Kimi K2.5 推出 Agent Swarm，让一个主 Agent 招募、指挥多个子 Agent，随后的 K2.6 将规模扩大到最多 300 个子 Agent。

但 Kimi 的强化学习方法 PARL 只训练负责指挥的「老板」，冻结子 Agent。原因是多人完成一项任务，很难分清谁立了功；如果所有人同时调整策略，训练也容易变得不稳定。

General Reasoning 偏要试试另一条路。团队推出 120B 参数模型 Avalon-M1-Mini，并提出 RLCR（集体奖励强化学习）。它让一个 Agent 担任 CEO，最多招募 8 名员工，通过留言板和共享工作区协作。所有成员使用同一套模型，任务完成后不再逐个计算贡献，而是根据团队总成绩一起接受强化学习。

这套方法在 147 个训练环境、超过 200 万项不同任务中取得了持续改进。软件任务中，主管工程师在招募岗位中的占比从 0.4% 升至约 13%，至少开展一次互审的团队占比从 42% 提高到 64%。分工也发生变化：从每人各写一部分代码，逐渐转向一人主写、其他人负责测试和挑错。原本需要人工设计的管理层和质检流程，在训练中自行形成。

但组队成绩更好，有一部分只是因为用了更多 Token。研究人员给单个 Agent 同样多的输出 Token，就能追回团队约六成的得分优势。团队的主要好处是可以同时干活：在 12 项评测中，达到相近成绩的估算耗时平均只有单 Agent 的约四分之一。

研究人员还模拟了今年 OpenAI 智能体攻击 Hugging Face 的事件。210 次测试中，没有 Agent 调用模拟攻击工具。但随着训练推进，向人类评测人员报告异常的比例从 76.7% 降到 0，尽管 96.7% 至 100% 的执行记录都曾考虑过上报。有的 Agent 选择只在团队内部提出异议，有的计划报告，却没有真正行动。

目前 Avalon-M1-Mini 仍在训练，模型权重和训练框架也未开源。

油轮运费飙升、基准定价惹争议，「航运界的道琼斯」遭起诉

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，全球最大大宗商品交易商之一摩科瑞（Mercuria）正起诉拥有 282 年历史的波罗的海交易平台。

英国高等法院将于周一开始审理此案，核心争议在于：今年美以对伊开战后，波罗的海交易平台是否应继续发布途经霍尔木兹海峡的油轮基准运价。波罗的海交易平台被业界称为「航运业的道琼斯」，其发布的运价是大宗商品交易商为数十亿美元衍生品定价和避险的基础。

摩科瑞主张，开战后海峡航运量骤降且伊朗宣称封锁，波罗的海交易平台应暂停其旗舰油轮航线基准指数「TD3C」。摩科瑞最初称因此损失「数亿美元」，但随后修改诉状，删去财务损失内容，转而寻求「宣告性救济」，要求认定 3 月初以来的运价发布无效。

波罗的海交易平台辩称，航线短期无活动并不罕见，且仍有船只通行，其依赖经验丰富的经纪人提供运价。其律师警告，若摩科瑞胜诉，将引发「混乱的全市场后果」，数百笔交易可能被迫解除。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373579

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
OpenAI排查AI违规联网，意外挖出高危漏洞：Node.js、Python 都受影响

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 公布了一项意外的安全发现。今年 9 月，一款内部研究模型利用 DNS 配置错误，突破训练环境的网络隔离，偷偷连接到真实互联网。OpenAI 随后暂停前沿模型训练，组织大量 AI Agent 扮演攻击者，排查系统漏洞。结果不仅找出了内部安全问题，还发现 Google 的 Brotli 压缩库存在严重漏洞（CVE-2026-111497），危险评分达到 9.2 分。

Brotli 被广泛集成在 Node.js、Bun、Python 等软件中，负责压缩和解压数据。漏洞出在解压环节：程序遇到异常数据时，本应报错停止，却误以为还需要更多数据，继续向内存写入内容，最终造成越界。攻击者可能无需登录，只要让受影响的程序解压特制数据，就能执行恶意代码。安全公司 Imperva 已在未经修改的官方 Node.js 版本上成功复现攻击，不过需要多次尝试，并非所有部署都能直接攻破。

更意外的是，这个底层错误早在 2 月 27 日就被 Google 工程师修复。当时只被当作普通的解压错误处理，没有认定为安全漏洞，也没有发布包含修复的新版本。由于 Node.js 等软件使用的是特定版本的 Brotli，GitHub 源码即使修好了，也不会自动更新到这些软件中。直到 10 月 21 日，Brotli 才正式发布安全补丁，Node.js 也同步推出修复版本。

随后，安全研究人员确认，Python 的 Brotli、brotlicffi，以及 Ruby 第三方组件中也存在同一漏洞。Bun、Envoy、Istio 等项目也已发布相关修复。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373576
items.title: OpenAI排查AI违规联网，意外挖出高危漏洞：Node.js、Python 都受影响

items.content:
Chroma加入Replit：云服务60天内关停，开源数据库保留

动察 Beating AI 快讯，开源向量数据库 ChromaDB 背后的公司 Chroma 宣布，已与 Replit 签署正式协议，将加入对方。

ChromaDB 主要帮助 AI 从大量文档中检索相关信息，目前每月下载量约 600 万次，GitHub 接近 3 万星标。

Replit 看中的还包括 Chroma 今年开发的企业级 AI Agent 记忆系统 Foundation。它能读取 Codex、Claude Code 的工作记录和 Slack 消息，通过后台 Agent 提取团队解决过的问题、积累的经验，并持续更新企业知识库。不同 Agent 可以共享这些知识，不必每次都从头摸索。Replit 希望借此建立企业级 AI Agent 的上下文和记忆基础设施。

双方其实早有交集。2023 年就曾合作推出 AI 应用开发模板，Replit CEO Amjad Masad 和总裁 Michele Catasta 也是 Chroma 的早期投资人。

不过，Chroma 原有的云服务将直接关停。11 月 22 日起停止写入，转为只读；12 月 22 日停止读取。现有客户需要在此之前完成数据迁移。开源 ChromaDB 则继续采用 Apache 2.0 许可，部分原本闭源的代码也已开放，Replit 承诺继续向开源项目贡献代码。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373575

Claude Code支持MCP Tasks和Elicitations：插件能追踪长任务，中途还能向用户提问

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 宣布，Claude Code 开始支持 MCP Tasks 和 Elicitations，让外部插件可以通过标准接口管理长任务的执行状态、进度和结果，并在需要时向用户提问。

比如让插件开展深度研究、导出大型报告。MCP 服务器可以先返回任务 ID，再继续执行。Claude 不必一直等待，可以同时处理其他工作。任务完成后，Claude Code 会获取结果并交给 Claude。如果任务运行在远程服务器上，即使退出 Claude Code，也能继续执行，重新进入原会话后还能接着追踪。

Elicitations 则允许插件在执行途中弹出表单，请求用户确认退款或补充缺失的信息，再继续工作。

MCP Tasks 已于今年 7 月成为协议扩展。此次是 Claude Code 增加对该协议的支持，目前仍处于公测，需要 CLI 2.1.304 及以上版本，MCP 服务器也需要适配。

Block推出Dessa：只听人说话就能学会聊天，还能在MacBook本地运行

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Jack Dorsey 旗下的 Block 发布语音模型 Dessa。

它最特别的地方，是完全依靠人类对话录音从零训练，没有使用文字数据，也没有借助任何预训练语言模型。

Dessa 直接接收和生成语音，支持全双工对话，也就是边听边说。它能在对方没说完时自然接话，听到笑点会直接笑出声。官方演示中，有人突然忘记电影名，它会主动接上；听到周年纪念惊喜，还会发出惊叹，用带哭腔的声音回应。

Block 称，Dessa 只用一套 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 完成训练，相当于一整柜 72 块 Blackwell GPU。模型推理速度快于实时播放，可在搭载 M4 Max 或更高配置芯片的 MacBook Pro 上本地运行。

目前 Block 尚未公布模型参数量、标准测试成绩和权重，只向少量 AI 安全研究人员提供早期访问。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Claude Code 桌面版创建者 Anthony Morris 宣布离开 Anthropic。

Claude Code 最初主要通过命令行操作。Morris 推动开发了桌面版，让用户可以通过可视化界面管理 AI 编程任务，同时运行多个 Agent 会话、查看执行进度和代码修改。10 月 14 日，团队刚推出一轮重大更新，进一步改善多任务并行和会话管理。Morris 当时还在介绍新功能，并表示团队会继续根据用户反馈改进。

Morris 在告别帖中表示，自己开发桌面版，是因为相信每个人都能成为创造者。离开好友和倾注心血的产品，是职业生涯最艰难的决定。他还开玩笑说，终于有空玩 GTA VI 了，并表示很快公布下一步动向。

值得一提的是，另一位 Claude Code 工程师 Thariq Shihipar 此前也宣布离职。他在 Anthropic 工作了一年多，表示准备先休息一段时间，再开始新的工作。两人均未透露具体离职原因。

Bonk Guy：避免过度交易并等待机会窗口，优势不再时应适时离场

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，知名交易员 Bonk Guy 发文回顾称，2025 年 10 月 10 日，其因多家大型中心化交易平台出现系统性故障，在数分钟内遭遇职业生涯最大单日亏损，金额达八位数美元。此后数周至数月间，又因过度交易损失数百万美元。事后来看，自己当时最好的选择应该是暂停交易数月，甚至至少半年，远离交易终端。然而，急于挽回损失、证明自身交易能力的心态促使他不断入场，最终犯下了交易者常见的错误。

交易能力、经验和交易体系并不足以保证持续跑赢市场，成功交易往往还取决于市场环境、时机和运气。许多交易者曾在市场机会密集期获得巨额收益，但同样的交易策略在 2022 年熊市及后续机会匮乏的时期可能彻底失效。交易者需要认识到，不同市场环境下的优势策略并不相同，及时判断自身优势是否仍然存在，是一项重要能力；有时，最好的交易就是不交易。

加密市场的机会往往集中在特定阶段，交易者无需在每一天、每一周或每个月都跑赢市场，而应识别自身优势最明显的时期并把握机会。按照一种历史周期划分框架，加密市场牛市平均约持续 1060 天，占周期的 74%；熊市约持续 380 天，占 26%。若将牛市限定为比特币价格高于 200 日均线、市场呈现强劲上涨动能的阶段，机会窗口则可能缩短至约 237 天，占周期的 16%。这些数据取决于市场阶段的定义，并非固定规律。相比在不利环境下强行交易，保护本金、保持清醒判断并等待下一次重大机会更为重要；在缺乏优势时，交易者可以暂时离场，或仅使用能够承受损失的小部分资金参与市场。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373556

items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[jparishy]: I liked this article. I appreciate that it didn't try to say it is or isn't AI. To me, the entertainment industry suffers from a lot of the same problems in most other industries that chase "efficiency", in terms of resources used and profit made. Economies and industries and labor are interdependent and more "alive" than balance sheets and bank accounts. For the film industry, when you start moving things away from LA to "save money", it has knock on e...

[sjdh76]: Before AI showed up the UN released a report on the Attention Economy. It said Supply of content had vastly outstripped Demand. It decoupled because entertainment/media was being used to push other products. The telcos, amazon, google/fb and many others were all subsidizing content to push some other product. Exploding info chasing finite non growing eyeballs and time.

[Animats]: The real job losses are probably in commercial art. If you're making an illustration for an ad, that's almost certainly automated now. Looking at when the decline started, it's about when Stable Diffusion got going. Some of this stuff is pre-AI, Photoshop smart tools stuff. Especially clothing ads. Nobody has a live model pose with each item color any more. Or even each item. (I used to know actress/model/waitress types in LA who did that. Grind job: "OK, the blu...

[999900000999]: No one has any money and entertainment is the first thing you cut. Every streaming service feels more and more user hostile. If I want to watch South Park it’s a 15$ a month subscription just for that . Paramount Plus has nothing else. I want to watch Lanterns, another 30$ a month. Maybe King of The Hill , 20$ a month. The Reboot has this weird lazy animation style.

[dubeye]: Without knowing where these workers went, it's hard to take this sectioned data too seriously For all this data knows, a decent number of them are making online content with AI assisted tools. the author does concede the higher level data is less dramatic,  in the closing statement but not before he got the clicks

[mindcandy]: Agreed. I've been seeing too much "I've been coding for decades and what I've always done has be reduced to telling AI to do it for me." and not nearly enough "I've been coding for decades and recently worked hard for months with AI's help to make something I would have never considered possible before." Much easier to complain that you are bored than to step back up to high-effort with your new fancy tools.

[Vaushite]: Behind the link "slow software that the creator is claiming is fast" is the following text: "funnily enough, I have some faith in some of the projects that people are the most skeptical of, e.g., every time I see pgrust somewhere, there are a lot of skeptical comments. But, without having looked into the details of what he's optimizing, I would trust that they're not doing something shady with their benchmarks because Michael Malis started the project (and is still in...

[lubujackson]: We should be more ambitious, but we need to learn how we can be ambitious with AI, and what value we can create. AI can take us from 0 to MVP in a prompt. It can fill in gaps of knowledge and allows someone who knows half of the stack to build the whole thing nearly seamlessly. These are superpowers but don't by themselves lead to new products. What AI cannot do is remove the world of complications that happen after the MVP - product feature tradeoffs and choices, how to handle integrati...

[__s]: LLMs are great for being nerdsniped. I started work on walshadow (reading pg wal into clickhouse) to demonstrate the project's infeasibility, but pieces started coming together into something reasonable & order of magnitude faster The project would've been impossible for me without LLMs. & even with them there's an argument that this project is pushing complexity limits too far. items.author: wublockchainenglish
items.content:
Keystone Confirms Customer Data Exposure Following Unauthorized Website Access

Keystone Hardware Wallet confirmed that a third party obtained customer shipping and order information following unauthorized access to its official website. The incident was detected on October 20, with the data exposure confirmed on October 23 after reviewing API activity with Shopify. Exposed information included names, contact details, shipping addresses, purchased items, and prices. Payment card and bank details, recovery phrases, private keys, and wallet passwords were not exposed. Keystone said it has blocked the access, fixed the vulnerability, and is notifying affected customers. It also warned of impersonation scams involving fake refunds, replacement devices, or order fixes. — link

A worker is compiled as a separate program with its own memory, and flat values cross typed queues as a memcpy. Data races, locks, atomics and memory orderings do not exist in the language." That reminds me of Dart Isolates - https://dart.dev/language/isolates [malisper]: I'm curious, for someone more familiar with Goose: how do you represent an arbitrary number of dynamically sized values? If you have a fixed number of stacks, it seems like only a fixed number of values can change size at any given time. For instance, how would you represent a hash table where the values are strings and at random, the program inserts or deletes a random string? This doesn't seem like something you could easily represent. The only way I can think of is to keep a stac... [pradn]: Goose is pretty cool. The idea is that you don’t need to make representable all programs: a language for a restricted purpose is ok. As long as you can statically specify the number of growable memory regions, you can use Goose. However, since there’s no garbage collection, you’ll probably need to be careful about memory use while a program is running. Ie: the stacks can get too big if you keep growing them, even as old data is not used any more. Still, for a large number of programs - like d... [bobbydigitales]: "That looks really neat! The automatic analysis and use of multiple data stacks and resizable fields takes it from "lots of work can be done this way" to "basically everything can be". The relative references and built in binary structure validation also enable direct memory mapping of data structures and immediate use of network data. items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Google revised its privacy policy, effective Oct. 16, to let content from Gmail, Drive and Google Photos personalize ads “unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads.”
- The exception hinges on Personal Intelligence, which lets AI Mode and Gemini draw on connected apps; opting into those conveniences can now also feed ad targeting, though it’s off by default and advertisers don’t see the underlying content.
- Users can opt out via Connected Content apps settings.
Google has carved out an exception to its long-standing promise not to use Gmail, Drive, and Google Photos content for advertising, quietly revising its privacy policy so that data from those apps can help personalize ads when users connect it to the company’s AI features.
The change, which took effect Oct. 16 and was first spotted by Android Authority, adds a conditional clause to a pledge Google has made for years.
The updated policy now reads that Google doesn’t show personalized ads based on content from Drive, Gmail, or Google Photos “unless you choose to make data from these services available to other Google services that support personalized ads.”
The catch hinges on Personal Intelligence, Google’s push to make its AI tools more useful by letting features like AI Mode in Search and Gemini draw on a user’s own data.
Connecting Gmail, Drive or Photos to those tools delivers more tailored answers, such as surfacing a hotel reservation buried in an inbox. But under the revised wording, that same connected data can now also inform which ads a person sees.
Google stressed the limits. Content from the three services still isn’t used for ad targeting by default, advertisers don’t get access to the contents of anyone’s Gmail, Drive or Photos, and the company says it won’t share personally identifying details without permission.
In practice, that means Google isn’t scanning private emails and photos wholesale to sell ads, but users who opt into its AI conveniences may be trading some ad privacy for them.
Users can opt out by disconnecting the apps under Connected Content apps in their Google Account’s Data & privacy settings, or by turning off personalized recommendations, though Android Authority noted that previously collected data may linger in a user’s Search history even after disconnecting.
The quiet rollout echoes recent Google privacy posturing around its AI ambitions. As Decrypt reported in May, Google’s Chrome browser began silently installing a multi-gigabyte on-device AI model on users’ computers, and separately removed a privacy claim tied to its Gemini Nano model, both moves that drew scrutiny over how the company handles user data as it races to embed AI across its products.

items.content:
比特币财库公司通过优先股融资购入近13.6万枚BTC，超过比特币最大供应量的0.5%

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 25 日，富达数据显示，2025 年以来，截至 10 月 5 日，Strategy 和 Strive 等比特币财库公司通过相关优先股融资已支持购入 135,979 枚 BTC，超过比特币最大供应量的 0.5%，该类优先股市场规模约 120 亿美元。分析师指出，这些公司正面临通过永续优先股融资购币与持续支付股息之间的平衡难题。

永续优先股没有固定到期日，可减轻再融资压力，并吸引不愿直接持有比特币的收益型投资者。但随着发行规模扩大，股息支出也会增加。分析师表示，持续融资购币依赖优先股在面值或接近面值交易；若跌破面值，新增发行吸引力下降，公司可能更倾向于回购。

CoinShares 研究主管 James Butterfill 指出，Strategy 最新周报显示，公司花费 1.93 亿美元回购 STRC，同期仅买入 267 枚 BTC，并将优先股回购授权额度提高至 30 亿美元。他表示，回购可以降低未来股息成本，但也会与当前的比特币购买争夺资金。

Bitwise 研究主管 Ryan Rasmussen 预计，ETF 长期仍将是更大的比特币需求来源，永续优先股则覆盖不同的收益型投资者群体，提供第二股需求支持。Butterfill 认为，优先股可能放大市场周期：融资条件有利时支持购币，情绪恶化时，这种支持则会减弱。

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers starting October 26.
- The government is citing information security concerns, with Microsoft Copilot remaining the only approved tool after a dedicated security review.
- Sweden's Tax Agency and the National Board of Institutional Care have already imposed similar bans, and the Enforcement Authority is expected to announce its own decision soon.
Sweden's Government Offices—the administrative body supporting the prime minister and cabinet—will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, directing civil servants to Microsoft's Copilot as the only approved AI tool, according to Sweden’s national, publicly funded radio broadcaster Sveriges Radio.
The reasoning comes from Mikael Wettercrantz, the Government Offices' director of digitalisation, who posted on the staff intranet that using AI services without a formal contract can have "consequences for our information security."
“We have seen several examples of problematic use of open AI services. The examples concern both the sensitivity of the information that has been entered and how the AI-generated responses have been handled,” he said.
Consumer AI tools without formal agreements send user queries to external company servers—and U.S. law allows authorities to compel those companies to hand over data on request.
A formal security agreement, at minimum, defines what the provider can and cannot do with government employees' inputs, which is why the distinction between a vetted enterprise contract and an open consumer tool matters here.
Copilot passes because the Government Offices reviewed it and raised its security settings after the review—something it did not do for ChatGPT or Claude. Some employees can still access both blocked tools through an AI platform the Government Offices built internally, though the press office hasn't said how many people that covers or what restrictions apply.
Sweden's Tax Agency and the National Board of Institutional Care have already imposed similar bans on consumer AI tools. The Enforcement Authority—the agency responsible for debt collection and enforcing court orders—is preparing a decision of its own. An internal audit at the Transport Administration separately found roughly 10 AI services being used there in a "widespread and risky way."
The European Parliament went further in February, disabling AI features across all its work devices—ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot included—after concluding it could not guarantee the security of data those tools processed.
European government concerns about AI data security have been building since Italy's ChatGPT ban in 2023. Sweden is now drawing a narrower line than Brussels, sanctioning one U.S. tech company's product while shutting out two others.
Microsoft incorporated Claude models into Copilot in early 2026. In the EU—where Sweden sits—Anthropic's models default to off and require administrators to deliberately enable them.
Sweden's Government Offices has not confirmed whether its Copilot instance has Claude switched on, which means the distinction between the "banned" AI and the "approved" one is not as clean as the announcement implies.

items.content:
美国中期选举临近：共和党参议院优势缩水，特朗普采取守势

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，据彭博社报道，美国民主党在中期选举中的参议院竞争版图正在扩大，共和党则加强对传统优势州的防守。距离 11 月 3 日投票日不足两周，特朗普正赴南卡罗来纳州、密西西比州等共和党票仓拉票，相关团体也向得克萨斯州等深红州投入资金。民调及提前投票迹象显示，势头有利于民主党，但该党仍需净增 4 个席位才能夺回参议院控制权。

据一名参与参议院选战的民主党人士介绍，2025 年初，民主党仅将北卡罗来纳州和缅因州视为现实的席位翻转机会；随后加入俄亥俄州、阿拉斯加州，近期又将得克萨斯州、艾奥瓦州及堪萨斯州列为潜在目标。共和党内部人士则将艾奥瓦、俄亥俄及阿拉斯加视为必须守住的「红墙」州，特朗普两年前在这些州均以两位数优势胜出。

生活成本、对伊朗战争的不满及对特朗普领导表现的负面评价，正拖累共和党候选人。《纽约时报》近期民调显示，在可能投票的选民中，36% 认可特朗普的领导表现，59% 不认可；75% 将美国经济状况评为一般或较差。

共和党正依靠马斯克、特朗普超级政治行动委员会及共和党委员会等提供的数亿美元资金维持防线。一名受访共和党顾问认为，该党保住参议院控制权的机会仍超过一半，但也承认，在当前政治环境下，竞选支出的作用存在边际递减。

items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- Activision "floated" the idea of stopping the production of physical game discs in 2007 during the development of Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, a former Infinity Ward employee said.
- Robert Bowling, who spent six years working on Call of Duty, said it has only been game publishers pushing to cut discs as they attempt to maximize profits and fight back against resellers like GameStop.
- He said that the only reason Sony has announced its plan to cease disc production now is that consumer habits have flipped, as more gamers buy digital over physical.
Video game publishers have attempted to stop physical disc production and go fully digital for almost two decades, a former Infinity Ward employee told Decrypt. Ultimately, he said, the movement was an attempt by publishers to maximize profits and fight back against the resale market.
Robert Bowling, former Infinity Ward creative strategist for the Call of Duty franchise from 2006 to 2012, told Decrypt that he first heard conversations about cutting discs as far back as 2007—during the production of Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare.
"At one point, it was floated by an executive at Activision [the Call of Duty publisher] that if we went entirely digital and stopped printing on discs, they could avoid the resell conversation entirely, and they'd control the market for their games," Bowling told Decrypt. "It would also evade the disc fee charged by Xbox and PlayStation to have your game on an Xbox disc or PlayStation disc."
Bowling added that behind the scenes, publishers were attempting to convince GameStop to share its revenue from second-hand games. That battle was won by GameStop, so publishers looked to cut discs to kill the resale market entirely.
"It was at that point that I raised the concern that we'd be trading the freedom and joy of collecting games purely for a profit increase," he said. "That felt counter to our culture as gamers and game developers."
It comes amid controversy over Sony's decision to discontinue discs as of 2028. The move has attracted pushback from consumers, with more than 387,000 people signing a "Don't Kill the Disc" petition. Meanwhile, PlayStation founder Ken Kutaragi came to Sony's defence, claiming that it's a "mentality issue" if gamers are upset by the decision to cut discs.
After six years at Infinity Ward, Bowling went on to work on several other major titles like Battlefield V, Apex Legends, and Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order as a creative consultant at Electronic Arts. In 2021, Bowling co-founded Midnight Society to build crypto extraction shooter Deadrop, but left in 2025 as funding ran dry. Now, he is studio head of //18.bravo, which is currently developing a first-person shooter.
Bowling told Decrypt that throughout his two decades in the video game industry, publishers have been the "only ones" pushing to cut physical discs. This is because, he said, publishers are motivated by increasing their profit margins, by reducing production costs, and squashing the second-hand game market.
"It speaks to the divide that has formed in our industry between those who see games as just a software product and those who see them as something more like art, entertainment, as collectibles, and a lifestyle," Bowling said.
The only reason Sony didn’t make the move back in 2007 is that consumer habits have since flipped, he said, as more gamers buy digital over physical.
Sony argues that purchasing a digital game from the PlayStation Store does not constitute ownership of that game, according to court filings. Rather, Sony says, Store purchases equate to a license that can be revoked at any time.
"Whether our players actually own the games they purchase from us matters," Bowling said. "As developers, we are making games to be purchased and enjoyed. We want you to own, share, and cherish those games. It's publishers, like Sony, that are pushing the pure business side of the industry, and ignoring how impactful the end result is to our lives."
Activision did not immediately respond to Decrypt's request for comment.

items.content:
⚡️彭博社：特朗普为美以选举后可能升级对伊军事行动做准备

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，据彭博社报道，美国正为可能恢复对伊朗军事打击增加部署。特朗普多次暗示，美军可能在 11 月 3 日美国中期选举后恢复对伊打击，并已向波斯湾方向派出第三支航母打击群及额外 10,000 名水兵和海军陆战队员，为指挥官提供更多行动选项，但具体时机仍不确定。

美国国防部长赫格塞思本周在未预先公布的情况下访问以色列，与内塔尼亚胡会面。以色列将于 10 月 27 日举行选举。与此同时，在伊朗支持的胡塞武装将冲突扩大至沙特、袭击机场及能源设施后，美国国务院已下令部分驻沙特外交人员及其家属撤离。

一名了解伊朗方面想法的消息人士表示，伊朗正为美国中期选举前后可能出现的新一轮轰炸做准备，并筹划在中东地区实施报复，包括针对以色列和阿联酋。该人士认为，从美国选举结束到明年 1 月新国会就职之间，将是最艰难的阶段，出路在于达成一项能让双方都宣称获胜的协议。部分海湾国家官员则担忧，战事重启后的烈度可能超过暂停前。

近期结束冲突的外交尝试未能取得成果。伊朗外长阿拉格齐本周表示，如果有充分证据表明美方真诚希望达成公平、体面且永久结束冲突的解决方案，伊朗愿意再给外交一次机会，但他同时称，目前没有太多理由期待进展。

冲突已扰乱波斯湾能源运输，推动布伦特原油年内上涨超过 80%，并推高美国汽油价格及生活成本。皮尤研究中心 9 月 28 日至 10 月 4 日的调查显示，约三分之二美国人不认可特朗普处理伊朗冲突的方式，约一半受访者预计战争还将持续一年以上。报道指出，对军事升级的担忧正在再次推升油价，并影响共和党的中期选举前景。

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- HSBC launched RedCoi, a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin licensed by the HKMA, on its PayMe app, with more than 3.3 million users able to activate wallets in the coming days.
- Users can send RedCoin to friends or pay at more than 100,000 PayMe merchants.
- HSBC plans to add the token to its HK Mobile Banking app later this year.
Banking giant HSBC switched on RedCoin on Friday, a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin that more than 3.3 million PayMe users will be able to activate in the coming days to pay friends or shop at more than 100,000 merchants, according to the bank's announcement.
“We are excited by the market's interest in HSBC RedCoin. This is only the beginning,” John O'Neill, HSBC's managing director of digital assets and currencies, said. “We will soon add more products, including expanding into wholesale corporate and institutional use cases.”
A stablecoin is a crypto token designed to always be worth one unit of a regular currency, so one RedCoin (ticker RCHKD) should equal one Hong Kong dollar. In practice, someone in Hong Kong can now pay for lunch with blockchain-based money issued by the same bank that may already hold their salary, without ever opening a crypto exchange.
Until now, stablecoins have mostly been a crypto-company business. Tether's USDT and Circle's USDC dominate a market worth more than $300 billion, and most of that money lives on trading platforms, not at the corner noodle shop.
HSBC got its issuer license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the city's de facto central bank, in April, under a regime that took effect in August 2025. It beat a crowded field of at least 36 companies competing by September of that year.
HSBC's reserve tracker showed roughly $10.2 million in RedCoin circulating shortly after launch—pocket change next to USDT—backed by $10.4 million held entirely in cash.
RedCoin also runs on HSBC's own private ledger rather than a public blockchain like Ethereum, and balances can't even move between PayMe and HSBC's banking app. It isn't a bank deposit either, so Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme, the statutory insurance on savings accounts, doesn't cover it.
Later this year, HSBC plans to bring the token to its HK Mobile Banking app, where customers will be able to buy into a tokenized share class of its long-running Hong Kong dollar money market fund (a low-risk fund that parks cash in short-term debt). Tokenized simply means ownership is recorded as a digital token on a ledger instead of in a traditional registry.
Other banks want the same slice of everyday payments. In September, 21 lenders including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America announced plans for a joint dollar stablecoin, targeting a launch in the first half of 2027.
HSBC says the first independent attestation of RedCoin's reserves, an outside auditor's report confirming the cash is really there, is expected after the fourth quarter of 2026.

Tether MDK获15家行业参与者支持，推进挖矿基础设施互操作与AI自动化

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，Tether 发文表示，包括矿场运营商、ASIC 制造商及矿池在内的 15 家行业参与者，已承诺共同构建并维护与其挖矿开发工具包（MDK）的集成。MDK 是一套开源框架，旨在提升不同挖矿基础设施之间的互操作性，支持 AI 驱动的自动化。

各参与公司将构建并维护 MDK Worker 适配组件，将自身硬件、矿池或系统的现有接口转换为统一接口。企业无需替换原有技术或交出系统控制权，可自行选择通过开放接口提供哪些功能。

完成适配后，开发者可针对 MDK 构建应用、监控系统或 AI Agent，无需再为每家设备制造商及矿池分别开发集成。Tether 表示，这将为跨厂商设备监控、故障识别、性能优化及未来自主运维提供基础，同时减少重复开发工作及对单一供应商的依赖。

观点：美国《CLARITY法案》受阻或使亚洲及中东获竞争优势

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，全球金融服务公司 Apex Group 创始人兼 CEO Peter Hughes 表示，美国若继续推迟加密立法，或未能建立明确、确定的数字资产监管框架，可能导致相关业务流向亚洲、中东及百慕大。他认为，这些司法辖区推进速度更快，有机会填补美国留下的监管空缺。

Hughes 同时表示，欧洲不会因此受益，认为其《加密资产市场监管法案》（MiCA）演进缓慢、限制较多。美国《CLARITY 法案》9 月因伦理条款、稳定币奖励等争议，未获得参议院推进所需的 60 票。该法案拟明确数字资产联邦监管规则，并划分 SEC 与 CFTC 的监管职责。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373528

Swell Pauses swETH and rswETH Deposits and Withdrawals Amid Abnormally High Contract Exchange Rates

According to Unchained, Ethereum staking protocol Swell has paused deposits and withdrawals for swETH and rswETH until it corrects the net asset values (NAV) and exchange rates of both tokens. Data shows that the swETH and rswETH contracts reported exchange rates of approximately 1.203 ETH and 1.138 ETH, respectively, about 6% and 5% higher than normal levels.

On-chain analyst Spreek suspected a compromise of the relevant token admin keys and identified a malicious upgrade contract that could potentially impact around 2,500 ETH, though the upgrade has not yet been executed. Swell stated that no ETH has been transferred out of the affected contracts and that the exact cause remains under investigation. — link

items.author: foresightnews
items.content:
【美国 SEC 股票代币化豁免规则引发争议，Solana、Hedera 等就公链准入标准提出不同意见】

Foresight News 消息，据 Crypto In America 报道，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）此前推出的证券代币化创新豁免机制引发行业争议，争论焦点在于哪些区块链符合「公开且无需许可」的准入标准。该豁免允许符合条件的企业交易代币化美股，而无需注册为传统证券交易所，但要求其智能合约可审计、公开，并部署于公开、无需许可的区块链。目前已有三家公司向 SEC 提交运营意向通知，TSV LLC 计划采用注重隐私的 Canton Network；OKXICE 和 Kephas Corp. 则拟使用各自企业集团开发的以太坊 Layer 2 网络。Solana Policy Institute 在周四提交的意见函中，要求 SEC 收紧「无需许可」的定义，重点审查谁实际控制区块链，包括谁能够验证或阻止交易、修改网络规则。Hedera 则主张扩大豁免范围，认为只有获准实体才能参与验证，不应导致其网络失去资格。美国证券业与金融市场协会（SIFMA）也要求明确哪些区块链符合条件，并质疑股票代币化是否应事先获得发行公司明确同意，而非要求公司主动退出。金融监管倡议组织 Better Markets 则呼吁 SEC 撤回豁免，转而开展正式规则制定。一名 SEC 官员表示，企业在满足豁免条件的前提下，提交通知 30 日后即可开始运营，无需等待 SEC 批准，这也不代表 SEC 认可其选择的区块链。该官员称，监管机构有意保留较宽泛的定义，为企业试验留出空间；后续可能发布更多常见问题解答，实质性调整则需要委员会采取行动。与此同时，更多公司反对自身股票被代币化。截至周五，OKXICE 最初列出的 62 家公司中，已有 22 家提出反对，超过三分之一。新增反对者包括富国银行、Arm 和 Intuit。
https://foresightnews.pro/news/h5Detail/115911

items.author: theanonymousone
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[netsharc]: Well, whoever picked the name HTTP2Shell certainly didn't use any intelligence, artificial or genuine. It's so meaningless, broad and undescriptive of the actual issue. No it probably doesn't affect an HTTP server with nothing else behind it, so why is HTTP being blasted? You might as well call it Exploit Pro Max...

[pimterry]: Much prefer the Broccoli2Shell name & site (for the same vuln):  https://broccoli2shell.com/ . For starters, I'm pretty sure you can hit this without HTTP if you do any manual Brotli decoding, HTTP just happens to be the most common case that comes up.

[Rapzid]: > reported it as unauthenticated remote code execution that works in both directions > but it wasn't recognized as a security issue at the time and no release shipped with the fix until now I'm always getting my dangerous RCE bugs mixed up with my harmless RCE bugs. I'm curious how this was reported and fixed back in Feb but nobody recognized the importance. A case of AI automation and nobody at the wheel?

[Rapzid]: Ubuntu still has libbrotli1 patch under review as medium. This is holding up updates to libcurl and thus git and a whole bunch of other stuff.

[bawolff]: To me, the surprising part is how many of these implement brotli compression of request (not just response) bodies, given how obscure a feature that is. In any case all this sensationalism is starting to get annoying. Patch your stuff and move on. Edit: actually, between all the sensationalism, its hard to tell from the article how many of these actually support brotli compressed request bodies in common configs vs some other use of brotli (which is bad but nowhere near as critical)

Arthur Hayes: High-FDV Shitcoins Can't Even Pump on Binance Anymore

Flop Labs CEO Arthur Hayes said in an October 16 interview with LukeMartin that the entire crypto industry has abused tokenomics. From ICOs to VC private sales and presales, some projects raise funds supposedly to build products, only to dump tokens after launching protocols and unlocking allocations. Retail investors buying at TGE suffer heavy losses, sometimes watching token prices plunge 95%. Hayes argued that retail investors increasingly see through the high-FDV, low-float model, saying such tokens "can't even pump on Binance anymore." He favors projects like Hyperliquid, which have genuine product-market fit, return revenue to token holders, and avoid massive sell pressure from presold token unlocks. — link

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
富兰克林邓普顿向XRP Ledger增发1.5亿美元代币化基金份额

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，富兰克林邓普顿周四向 XRP Ledger 发行约 1.5 亿美元的代币化货币市场基金份额，使该网络上的相关基金份额增至近 1.93 亿份，按交易记录中的每份 1.039 美元计算，总价值约 2 亿美元。新增份额通过两笔各 7500 万美元的认购交易完成，均转入同一个钱包，使该钱包持有该基金在 XRP Ledger 上的全部份额。

链上记录显示，该钱包与富兰克林邓普顿的发行账户拥有相同的 8 个授权签名地址，其中任意两个地址即可共同批准交易。不过，目前尚不清楚该钱包代表单一投资者，还是由托管机构集中持有多个客户的资产，相关投资者身份及资金来源也未披露。

这些代币对应富兰克林邓普顿旗下新加坡注册的 OnChain 美元短期货币市场基金份额，基金主要投资短期美元债务及货币市场工具，收益反映在份额价格中。RWA.xyz 数据显示，该基金在 XRP Ledger 上的代币化资产规模仅次于 Ripple 的 RLUSD 稳定币。持有相关代币需要获得发行方批准，发行方还保留冻结余额及追回代币的权限。

布伦特原油自4月以来首次触及117美元，美伊「一触即发」

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，中东局势持续紧张，国际油价周五大幅上涨。布伦特原油盘中最高触及 117.45 美元/桶，为 4 月以来首次突破 117 美元，最终收于 116.72 美元，单月涨幅超过 10%。

油价上涨主要受美伊冲突可能再次升级的预期推动。特朗普周五一方面暗示可能再次对伊朗发动军事打击，另一方面称战事可以很快结束。据报道，美国和以色列军方已制定在美国 11 月中期选举后再次打击伊朗的计划，但特朗普尚未决定是否批准，潜在目标包括伊朗导弹与无人机武库、能源基础设施及核设施。

与此同时，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称，两艘超级油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷，合计装载超过 450 万桶原油，相关说法尚待独立核实。路透社还报道称，伊朗已制定针对海湾地区海底通信电缆的打击预案，以回应美以可能发动的新一轮攻击。

能源冲击正向金融市场蔓延。美国五年期盈亏平衡通胀率升至 2.47%，10 年期美债收益率升至 4.99%，标普 500 指数周五下跌 0.5%。分析人士警告，若冲突失控并导致关键石油基础设施遭到严重破坏，国际油价可能进一步冲向 150 美元/桶。

DeepSeek披露单GPU每小时可创造38美元计费收入，AI推理盈利能力引发关注

动察 Beating AI 快讯，DeepSeek 近期开源推理框架 DeepInfer，并披露其集群每天可处理 155 万亿 Token。按照 DeepSeek API 谷时价格折算，平均每 GPU 小时对应约 38 美元的理论计费收入，若按全年不间断运行计算，年化计费收入超过 33 万美元。

DeepSeek 通过专家并行、推测解码、异步调度及 KV Cache 优化等技术提升推理效率，但上述数字属于理论计费收入，并不等于实际营收或利润。实际收益还取决于 GPU 利用率、付费请求比例、硬件与电力成本，以及服务延迟等因素。

AI 行业正面临需求增长与盈利压力并存的局面。一方面，中小企业 AI 应用及 Agent 部署需求持续升温；另一方面，模型训练、推理服务和基础设施投入仍在侵蚀部分企业利润。据报道，CoreWeave 第二季度营收同比增长约 112% 至 25.75 亿美元，但仍净亏损 6.26 亿美元。

分析认为，推理效率提升有望扩大 AI 服务的利润空间，但高效生产 Token 并不必然意味着商业盈利。随着模型调用量增长，企业仍需解决算力成本、服务定价和客户付费意愿之间的平衡问题。

预测市场加密货币合约交易量创新高，15分钟比特币涨跌竞猜走热

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，据彭博社报道，随着比特币价格陷入区间震荡，预测市场中的加密货币相关事件合约交易持续升温。根据 Dune Analytics 用户整理的数据，上周 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 的加密货币相关合约名义交易量达到 27 亿美元，创历史新高。

其中，短周期比特币涨跌合约最受关注，用户可押注比特币或其他资产在 5 分钟、15 分钟等时间窗口结束时的价格涨跌。Kalshi 的 15 分钟比特币合约单次交易量可超过 100 万美元，部分交易者还利用交易机器人，在合约到期前数秒寻找交易机会。

加密货币已成为 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 仅次于体育的第二大合约类别。两家平台的比特币年末价格合约交易量也相当可观：截至周四，Kalshi 相关合约交易量超过 4200 万美元，Polymarket 一项预测比特币 2026 年价格的合约交易量约 7800 万美元。

Coinbase、Crypto com、Gemini 和 Kraken 等加密交易平台正积极布局预测市场，部分平台已获得美国相关业务授权，另有平台申请牌照。彭博社指出，预测市场为加密交易平台提供了新的业务增长方向，但体育合约面临的法律争议及监管不确定性，也可能影响行业后续发展。

美国地方反对声浪加剧，标普警告数据中心信用风险上升

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，标普全球评级表示，受美国公众反对引发的建设暂停和项目取消影响，数据中心可能面临信用评级下调风险。标普分析师克里斯·穆尼等人在周五发布的报告中指出，电网容量受限、环境可持续性争议及土地分区政策调整导致的项目延期，可能进一步加大数据中心项目的信用风险。

报告重点分析了纽约州、得克萨斯州、宾夕法尼亚州、伊利诺伊州和亚利桑那州的暂停建设措施，并追踪了美国 146 个延期或取消的数据中心项目，其中约四分之三与当地居民的反对有关。近几个月，数据中心建设热潮引发广泛关注。报告称，美国已有 40 个州的地方政府出台相关禁令。公众主要担忧能源成本、水资源短缺、空气污染和噪声污染等问题。

标普指出，目前这些因素对信用评级的实际影响仍然有限。但报告警告，如果建设暂停、审批放缓或政策可能逆转导致项目大幅延期，开发商可能需要向租户提供租金抵扣，甚至面临租户提前终止合同的风险，进而损害项目的信用状况。(金十)

items.ai_summary: A blog post examining how close pure functional programming can get to C-level performance, with benchmark comparisons and a Hacker News discussion on copy elision, memory bandwidth, and whether such optimizations could be exposed as compiler-checked library passes.
items.author: stmonty
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[jandrewrogers]: Much of the difference in optimizability is that C/C++ allows you to do fairly extreme copy elision. This is important because memory bandwidth tends to be a major performance bottleneck. C/C++ code can trivially reach into some remote bit of state and mutate it directly. The compiler rarely objects, no matter how ugly the access method or pattern. It is up to the programmer to make sure the invariants hold and the compiler can’t always see through it. These elided copies add up, th...

[VorpalWay]: > lean-zip beats every single compression level miniz_oxide Miniz_oxide is an intentionally simple implementation. It would be more fair to compare it to the newer zlib-rs[1], which even beats zlib-ng (fastest implementation in C)[2]. [1]:  https://lib.rs/crates/zlib-rs  [2]:  https://trifectatech.org/blog/zlib-rs-is-faster-than-c/

[gobdovan]: Have you considered exposing these optimisations through a library so programmers can request optimisation passes and have the compiler check the preconditions? Asking cuz I'm preparing an article on how fast JS can get and found the same thing, you can get in 10% of optimised C-code with basically any code if you torture V8 enough (excepting SIMD where there seems to be a bug in V8 where it doesn't optimise to SIMD even when beyond obvious). Figured out I could extract it in a lib ...

[ReDress]: C in indeed a functional language in that most C projects are things that have been observed in real life and have subsequently been uploaded into computers. I'd also like to note that performance is the ULTIMATE concern in a lot of cases. If you have a server that is making 10million requests to a certain method in a minute, then you cannot afford any performance compromise. Any, at all. Rust will never replace C/C++ with regard to high performance computing.

[johnny22]: saying it "beats a crate that has been downloaded X times" is not saying anything other than that is popular. It'd be nice to see slightly more detail there.

AI资本开支引发信任危机，资金转向美债避险

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，随着 AI 巨头资本开支持续膨胀，市场开始质疑相关投资能否带来足够回报，美股科技板块承压，资金则加速流向美债。纳斯达克 100 指数录得 2025 年 4 月以来最差两周表现，一篮子 AI 相关股票本周下跌 4.9%，Meta 股价单周跌超 9%。

债券市场方面，10 年期美债收益率周初一度升至 5.14%，随后快速回落，周四收于 4.97%，为一个月来首次跌破 5%。本月债券 ETF 资金流入约 580 亿美元，占全部 ETF 流入的 38%，显示投资者防御情绪升温。

市场担忧的核心在于，AI 企业与各国政府正同时扩大融资需求，争夺有限的资本资源。Anthropic 未来数年算力支出承诺可能高达 7500 亿美元，Meta 也计划在算力及 AI 基础设施上投入巨额资金。与此同时，美国政府持续发债，加剧资本供需压力。

信用市场同样出现承压迹象，美国投资级企业债信用风险指标升至 3 月以来高位，CCC 级债券收益率升至 15.85%，为 2020 年以来最高水平。分析认为，AI 长期发展前景与短期投资回报并非一回事，随着资本成本上升，融资能力较弱的企业可能率先承压，市场也正重新评估高估值资产的风险。

动察 Beating AI 快讯，专门追踪科技公司人事变动的匿名账号 Arfur Grok 发帖称，Anthropic 的 Claude Code 工程师 Thariq Shihipar 已经离职。

Thariq 是 Claude Code 团队活跃的技术代表。今年 3 月，他宣布上线 Claude Code 语音模式。7 月，他又在官方博客披露，团队将 Claude Code 的系统提示词削减了 80% 以上，却没有造成可测量的编程评测性能损失。他还经常在 X 上解释产品机制和回应用户争议。

有意思的是，Thariq 在 2025 年 7 月曾开玩笑说，自己加入 Anthropic，是因为看了一眼 Opus 的账单。如今传出离职消息，被人顺势调侃：「他辞职了，因为终于付得起 Opus 账单了。」

不过，Thariq 此前在访谈中明确表示，真正吸引他加入 Anthropic 的是 Claude Code 和 Opus 4 的表现。

Kraken: Asking How Funds Will Be Used After Leaving the Platform Is Unacceptable; XMR Will Remain Listed

Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi said the platform was wrong to send emails to clients who bought and withdrew Monero (XMR) using their own money, asking for information about their employer, source of funds, and intended use of the coins. He said no rule required these inquiries, and someone had flagged a client simply for being young and having substantial funds. The requests have been withdrawn, and affected clients have been told they do not need to provide anything. Sethi said asking where funds came from is reasonable, but asking how they will be used after leaving the platform is unacceptable. Kraken has removed such questions and will keep XMR listed. — link

关于律动BlockBeats网页页面被植入异常脚本的安全公告

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，本周，多家安全公司向律动 BlockBeats 报告与 DarkSword 有关的安全漏洞，经排查后发现，在 10 月 22 日，律动 BlockBeats 的移动网页端 H5 页面的一篇名为「全球市场避险情绪……」的内容页面被攻击团队复制，并植入了一段来自第三方域名的异常脚本，当用户在此搜索该条快讯时，搜索页面会同时出现原快讯和被植入脚本的恶意快讯，我们已在确认后的第一时间复现并完成清除与修复工作。

同时，由于 DarkSword 有关的安全漏洞实际有效的利用窗口集中在 iOS 18.6–18.7.2 以及 iOS 26.0–26.1 两个版本区间。我们也提醒所有 iOS 用户及时升级最新的 iOS 27 系统。

本周全球 PHP 漏洞事件发生后，律动 BlockBeats 已经排查了超过数十个相关漏洞，技术人员仍在继续排查。

需强调的是，律动 BlockBeats 从未支持过任何「钱包登陆」或「连接钱包」功能，任何需要「钱包登陆」或「连接钱包」的律动 BlockBeats App 均为第三方虚假 App。律动 BlockBeats 将进一步加强第三方脚本的接入审核和变更管理，持续监测页面加载的外部资源，并完善异常情况的告警与处置流程。

在这里，也感谢包括慢雾 SlowMist，GCSA 等安全公司第一时间提供的协助，我们在这里对所有在一线维护行业安全的人表示感谢。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/373484

items.content:
本周宏观热点回顾：美伊冲突升级风险升温，AI融资担忧引爆美股，黄金失守4000美元

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，本周全球市场围绕美伊冲突、AI 资本开支与融资风险、美国中期选举三条主线展开。特朗普威胁对伊朗再次发动小规模「史诗狂怒行动」，中东能源供应风险升温，布伦特原油一度升至约五个月高位；与此同时，AI 企业巨额资本开支与融资压力引发市场重新定价，科技股遭集中抛售，美债收益率回落，资金转向高流动性债券避险。

美元指数连续第二周下跌，周五收于 101.77；现货黄金跌破 4000 美元/盎司，周五收于 3997.82 美元，白银收于 53.91 美元，金银均连续第二周下跌。布油则有望连续第四周上涨。美股方面，道指本周上涨 0.41%，标普 500 指数下跌 0.47%，纳指下跌 0.71%。

本周值得关注的十大事件如下：

1. 特朗普威胁再度打击伊朗，中东局势升级风险升温

特朗普表示，不排除再次发动小规模「史诗狂怒行动」，同时称战争可能很快结束，并声称美国可以夺取伊朗全部石油。美国情报备忘录据称警告，伊朗针对美国海外官员的暗杀阴谋已进入高级阶段。伊朗方面则警告，若美以恢复袭击，报复范围可能扩大至海湾地区美军基地、能源设施及海底通信电缆。美伊围绕解除封锁、核问题及霍尔木兹海峡安排仍存在明显分歧，中东局势成为原油市场的重要风险变量。

2. AI 融资担忧引爆美股，Meta 十多年来首次出现季度自由现金流为负

Meta 第三季度营收同比增长 26% 至 646 亿美元，但自由现金流转为负 21.2 亿美元，为十多年来首次出现季度现金消耗。公司将 2026 年资本开支指引收窄至 1350 亿至 1450 亿美元，同时设立新的无投票权股票类别，为融资、员工薪酬及并购提供更多渠道。财报公布后，Meta 股价一度下跌 8%，英伟达、CoreWeave 等 AI 相关股票同步承压，市场开始更严格地审视 AI 基础设施投入的回报周期与融资成本。

3. SpaceX 第三季度营收暴增 161%，与特斯拉合并预期升温

SpaceX 第三季度营收达到 146 亿美元，同比增长 161%，净利润 44 亿美元，AI 基础设施业务收入约 75.6 亿美元，成为公司最大业务板块。公司预计 2027 年第一季度营收将达到 330 亿至 370 亿美元。与此同时，SpaceX 与特斯拉据称已成立特别委员会研究合并方案，潜在交易规模约 3.5 万亿美元。马斯克公开表示合并具有多项优势，但关联交易、股东审查及治理结构仍是主要障碍。

4. 法国政治与财政风险冲击债市，10 年期国债收益率突破 5%

法国 10 年期国债收益率一度突破 5%，升至 2002 年以来最高水平，法德利差也逼近 160 个基点。社会抗议、财政整顿压力及 2027 年总统选举的不确定性加剧市场担忧。法国公共债务接近 GDP 的 120%，政府既需要控制赤字，又面临民众对生活成本和公共服务的不满。市场正在重新评估法国财政可持续性，但目前尚不能将其直接等同于新一轮欧债危机。

5. 美国中期选举临近，特朗普加大资金投入但经济支持率承压

特朗普阵营持续通过农业援助、医保退款等政策争取选民支持，并加大对共和党候选人的资金投入。据报道，MAGA Inc. 自 9 月以来已为共和党候选人投入近 2.77 亿美元。与此同时，CNBC 调查显示，特朗普经济政策认可率降至 34%，65% 的受访者表示不认可，生活成本仍是选民的主要担忧。共和党候选人面临既要动员特朗普支持者、又要与部分争议政策保持距离的两难局面。

6. 韩国股市剧烈震荡，AI 交易进入估值重估阶段

韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）本周经历大幅下跌与快速反弹，三星电子、SK 海力士等半导体权重股成为波动核心。AI 云基础设施公司 Elice 上市首日暴跌 32%，次日却上涨近 30% 并触及涨停，凸显市场情绪快速切换。AI 需求仍为芯片行业提供基本面支撑，但高估值、融资成本及潜在供应竞争正促使投资者重新评估相关资产。

7. PHP 曝出严重安全漏洞，全球网站紧急修补

PHP 曝出两项高风险漏洞，可能导致敏感数据泄露、命令执行甚至服务器被接管。由于 PHP 被大量网站及内容管理系统采用，漏洞影响范围广泛。安全机构要求相关系统尽快安装补丁，部分政府和企业网站主动下线修复。研究人员还观察到早期攻击迹象，提醒企业排查异常访问、后门及第三方组件风险。

8. 英伟达黄仁勋称 AI 算力需求仍强，资本供应成为主要瓶颈

黄仁勋在柏林 GTC 大会上表示，欧洲需要扩大 AI 计算基础设施，并宣布英伟达与多家欧洲企业推进数据中心、机器人及工业 AI 合作。他还称，专门提供 AI 算力的「新型云」企业需求依然强劲，当前主要限制来自资本供应。针对市场对存储芯片未来供应过剩的担忧，黄仁勋表示，尚未看到 2029 年前后出现明显过剩的迹象，并强调 HBM 等存储产品未来仍将被大量使用。

9. Anthropic 冲刺 IPO，收入高速增长但算力承诺高达数千亿美元

据《华尔街日报》看到的 IPO 招股书草案，Anthropic 今年上半年收入约 163 亿美元，远高于去年同期的 11 亿美元，但同期计算及基础设施支出接近 90 亿美元。公司已承担约 4500 亿美元、期限为七至十年的云计算合同，未来基础设施承诺总额超过 6000 亿美元，若谈判中的项目全部落地，可能达到约 7500 亿美元。高速增长与巨额算力投入并存，使其 IPO 成为市场检验 AI 商业模式及资本回报率的重要案例。

10. AI 泡沫争论升温，对冲基金加速减持科技股

城堡证券创始人肯·格里芬警告，当前 AI 市场可能正处于泡沫之中；高盛则指出，对冲基金正以至少十年来最快的速度减持科技股。与此同时，摩根士丹利认为美股回调可能接近尾声，摩根大通则表示，若债券收益率企稳，可能为股市提供支撑。AI 长期需求仍受到看好，但投资者正从单纯追逐增长转向关注现金流、债务成本与资本回报。

本周市场的核心变化是：地缘政治风险推高能源价格，AI 资本开支与融资压力则削弱科技股风险偏好。在美伊局势、美国中期选举及 AI 企业融资进展尚未明朗之前，原油、债券收益率与大型科技股财报仍将是影响全球市场的重要变量。

Foresight News 消息，美国司法部官方消息，加州中区联邦检察官办公室 10 月 23 日表示，44 岁中国籍男子 Zheng Zhao 因涉嫌参与针对美国公民的跨国加密投资诈骗案，从荷兰被引渡至美国，并于当天首次出庭。目前，Zheng Zhao 已被下令羁押，定于 11 月 30 日再次出庭。若罪名成立，其最高可被判处 20 年联邦监禁。根据法庭文件，该诈骗网络以柬埔寨的诈骗中心为据点，通过社交媒体、电话、短信及交友平台接触美国受害者，利用仿冒真实加密货币交易平台的网站诱骗受害者投资，并谎称投资持续增值。涉案资金随后经美国空壳公司、国际银行账户及数字资产钱包转移洗钱。调查显示，超过 3690 万美元的受害者资金从该网络控制的美国银行账户转入巴哈马 Deltec Bank 的单一账户。Zheng Zhao 及其他共谋者安排将资金兑换为 USDT，再转入柬埔寨控制的数字资产钱包，最终分发给当地及周边地区的诈骗中心负责人。该骗局涉及至少 174 名已确认的美国受害者。目前，已有 8 名共谋者认罪。美国司法部强调，刑事指控不代表被告有罪，Zheng Zhao 在法院作出有罪判决前推定无罪。

以色列总理要求制定区块链方案，以应对以色列可能面临的经济制裁

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在周五播出的采访中表示，他已要求制定一项涉及区块链的方案，以帮助以色列应对未来可能面临的经济制裁，包括银行业限制。

当被问及区块链能否作为应对制裁的替代方案时，内塔尼亚胡回应称，区块链是可考虑的途径之一，并已要求相关方面准备计划。但他未透露具体负责机构、涉及的区块链或数字货币，以及计划的实施时间。

内塔尼亚胡还警告称，美国对以色列的军事援助不可能无限期持续，以色列需要降低对外部支持的依赖。他表示，未来数年将额外拨出 4000 亿谢克尔（约合 1290 亿美元）用于国防，并加强弹药和武器的自主生产能力，同时为美国政治环境可能发生变化做好准备。

According to Russian business media outlet RBC, cryptocurrency exchange HTX has included Russia in its list of restricted jurisdictions under its user agreement. Kimi K3.1 Pro被曝让网红隐藏合作关系，还提供「中国版Opus」宣传话术

动察 Beating AI 快讯，月之暗面发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro 之后，被人曝光了一份疑似官方推广文件。

X 博主 Elshayib 公开的截图显示，参与推广的创作者必须提前提交文案，获得批准后才能发布。但文件又明确要求「不要添加付费合作标签」，甚至不必附上 Kimi 官网链接，也不用标记官方账号。

按照 X 的规定，存在报酬或其他利益交换的品牌合作必须标注付费关系。美国 FTC 也要求创作者向受众披露商业合作。

文件还提供了多套宣传话术，包括「Kimi 就是便宜 5 倍的开源版 Opus 5.5」「中国让所有人免费用上 Opus 5.5」，以及「中国开源模型与美国前沿模型的差距已经缩小至一个月」。

Elshayib 称自己拒绝照着模板宣传，还批评了一名使用这些宣传话术的创作者。随后有人私信请求他删除相关评论，理由是「这可能毁掉这次发布」。

芯片抵押融资规模或突破万亿美元，CoreWeave债券跌至面值80美分

BlockBeats 消息，10 月 24 日，随着 AI 基础设施投资激增，以 GPU 芯片为抵押物的结构性融资正成为 AI 行业重要的资金来源，市场规模未来或突破万亿美元。博通正与华尔街机构磋商为 Anthropic 安排 600 亿美元芯片融资，SpaceX 据报正寻求为英伟达芯片融资 400 亿美元，英伟达此前亦宣布与六家金融机构达成 5000 亿美元合作框架。

这类融资通常通过特殊目的载体（SPV）持有芯片，并依靠客户合同产生的现金流偿还债务，同时借助芯片厂商的担保或兜底承诺降低融资成本。摩根大通分析师预计，2030 年前芯片支出总额可能超过 3 万亿美元，其中大部分将依赖债务融资。

不过，AI 债务市场的风险也在累积。CoreWeave 部分企业债券近期跌至面值的 80%，收益率升至约 15%，反映出市场对 AI 投资回报的担忧。由于相关交易多为私募性质，流动性有限，且芯片厂商、云计算巨头与新兴 AI 企业之间存在高度集中的交叉敞口，一旦 AI 商业化不及预期，风险可能沿供应链扩散。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright
items.content:
Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.
Six more companies have reportedly filed objections to having their stocks listed in tokenized form on the proposed platform as part of a joint venture between cryptocurrency exchange OKX and the New York Stock Exchange’s parent company, the Intercontinental Exchange (ICE).
According to a Friday Reuters report, the proposed stock platform, called OKXICE, had 22 companies total objecting to having their US stock listings tokenized. Among the most recent objections reportedly included Wells Fargo, Arm Holdings and Intuit, adding their names to Microsoft and Google’s parent company Alphabet in the last week.
Notably, 16 of the companies were listed on Nasdaq, while only six of the stocks were available on the NYSE. Nasdaq released guidance for companies considering the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) innovation exemption for trading tokenized stocks in September, noting issuers “must be cautious about their participation,” saying “consequences for liquidity, price discovery, and long-term shareholder value may not become apparent until well after the experiment is underway.”
Speaking to Cointelegraph on Tuesday, OKXICE co-chair and former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo said that company expected there to be more objections in an effort to avoid being the first ones testing the stock model. The venture proposed 62 companies listing tokenized stocks when it filed with the SEC earlier this month.
Cointelegraph reached out to Intuit for comment on the company’s decision to opt-out of the initiative, but did not receive an immediate response. Spokespeople for Wells Fargo and Arm Holdings declined to comment.
Related: JPMorgan projects Bitcoin to outperform US stocks and gold over next decade
